subject: Emergency Medicine credentialing packet — Regional Medical Center
text:
Hello Acme Locums Credentialing Team,

Please find below the current credentialing requirements for Emergency Medicine physicians seeking initial appointment at Regional Medical Center. All items must be complete before the effective date; incomplete packets will be returned.

============================================================
REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER — CREDENTIALING PACKET
Emergency Medicine — Initial Appointment
Effective: 2026-11-01
============================================================

1. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
---------------------
  a. Active state medical license (Texas)
       - Signed provider attestation of accuracy required.
  b. Current DEA registration certificate.
  c. Board certification in Emergency Medicine (ABEM or AOBEM).
  d. Basic Life Support (BLS) card — AHA, Red Cross, or ASHI.

2. PRIMARY SOURCE VERIFICATION
------------------------------
  a. State medical license — verified directly with the Texas Medical Board
     within the last 90 days.

3. PRIVILEGE DELINEATION — EMERGENCY MEDICINE
---------------------------------------------
  a. General EM privileges.
  b. Procedural sedation — requires documented volume of at least
     20 cases in the preceding 12 months.

4. ATTESTATIONS
---------------
  a. Provider signature attesting that all information provided is
     accurate to the best of the provider's knowledge.

5. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS
--------------------------
  Return completed packet by email to:
       credentialing@regionalmed.example.com
  Deadline: no later than 14 days before the requested effective date.

Questions may be directed to the medical staff office at the address above.

Regards,
Medical Staff Services
Regional Medical Center
